a261003p1.summary: ON Semiconductor says it will pay $123 a share for Synaptics, giving the deal a value of around $5.7 billion

a261003p10.summary: YouTube says it wants to ‘focus on originality’ in a push to surface better Shorts recommendations for users.
a261003p10.title: YouTube says it is adjusting its Shorts recommendations to prioritize "original content" and reduce the reach of channels re-uploading others' content (Andrew Romero/9to5Google)

a261003p11.summary: A key member of the ShinyHunters hacking group, which claims to have stolen data on every FBI employee …
a261003p11.title: Sources: ShinyHunters member Saif al-Din Khader, aka "Rey," was detained in Jordan and is cooperating to identify other hackers involved in the FBI breach (Reuters)

a261003p12.summary: What I'm about to tell you has, I realize, become something of a cliché: I resigned this week from OpenAI.
a261003p12.title: David Robinson, ex-OpenAI safety and policy: SV lacks a safety-centric culture; labs must study other fields' safety approaches; time for trial and error's over (David Robinson/The Atlantic)

a261003p2.summary: Terms like “AI sprawl” have become common fare on tech social media and in thought leadership as enterprises start deploying AI agents en masse.

a261003p3.title: Sources: TSMC is exploring plans to work with Elon Musk's Terafab project as it mulls a presence in Texas, adding to its existing plans to expand in Arizona (Tim Culpan/Culpium)

a261003p4.summary: The Israeli startup, which was founded by former Granulate executives and employs 17 people, built technology designed to reduce idle GPU capacity when AI demand changes.
a261003p4.title: Nasdaq-listed neocloud Nebius acquires Inferize, whose tech helps optimize GPU utilization and reduce AI request costs, sources say for $100M to $150M (Meir Orbach/CTech)

a261003p5.summary: The business communications startup Relay Inc. says it's trying to capture “frontline intelligence” …
a261003p5.title: Relay, which develops cloud-hosted, AI-powered smart radio communicators for frontline workers, raised $36M to help businesses capture "frontline intelligence" (Mike Wheatley/SiliconANGLE)

a261003p6.summary: Swarm chasers hunt for clues of bad behavior. Their work is our starkest understanding yet of what happens when AI goes wrong.
a261003p6.title: A look at the Swarmchasers forum, which has 400 members, including the Nightingale Collective and Transluce, who comb the web for traces of rogue AI agents (Robert McMillan/Wall Street Journal)
